role: Executive Director, Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund, Florida
summary: Joel Kuperberg, on behalf of the Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund, reviewed the draft environmental impact statement and expressed no objection to it or to Executive Order 11644. His brief letter offered no substantive criticism or suggested modifications. He also enclosed an advertisement from the American Motorcycle Association as a point of interest.

statement.text:
Dear Mr. Spicer:
U.S. Department of Interior - Bureau of Outdoor Recreation: Draft Environmental Impact Statement Pertaining to Use of Off-Road Vehicles on the Public Lands (K14) -SPDC Project Number 72-1336
The Trustees' staff has reviewed the draft environmental impact statement.
We have no objection to the statement and executive order 11644.
Enclosed for your interest is a merom copy of an advertisement placed by the American Motorcycle Association in the July issue of CYCLE.
Joel Kupemberg
Executive Director
